stem: Which follow-up practice best improves the effectiveness of a space maintainer after it has been placed?

options.text: Examine the patient only if he or she reports a problem with the appliance.
Focus on the appliance alone and disregard the succedaneous tooth.
Regularly check the appliance's integrity and retention and watch the eruption of the succedaneous tooth.
Rely on patient compliance alone, without scheduled checks of the appliance.
